# GuiLib

> Web-style UI library for Minecraft Fabric mods (MC 26.1.x / 26.2 / 26.3, Kotlin): React-like function components and hooks
> in a Kotlin DSL with HTML tag names, styled with real CSS files (cascade, specificity, flexbox, variables, :hover …).
> Write it like React + CSS; px are GUI pixels and the default font-size is 8px.

Key facts:
- Components: `val App = component("App") { var n by useState(0); button(onClick = { n++ }) { +"Clicked $n" } }`
- Helper functions: declare them on the DSL receiver, `fun NodeBuilder.renderGraph(values: List<Int>) { div { … } }`, call inside any block; no hooks in helpers (use a component for state)
- Open: `GuiLib.open(App, stylesheets = listOf("modid:ui/app.css"))` (file at `assets/modid/ui/app.css`)
- Props: `className`, `id`, `style` (CSS string), `key`, `title`, `ref`, `onClick`/`onChange`/… (Kotlin lambdas)
- Hooks: useState, useEffect (no deps = once), useMemo, useRef, useContext, useInterval, useAsync / useFuture / usePromise (async data: loading / value / error / reload()), useDocumentEvent, useBodyClass / useBodyStyle (theme or font switch at runtime; body.classList / setStyleProperty like the DOM), useScreenScale(2.5f) / GuiLib.open(scale = …) (own GUI scale per screen, null = Minecraft's), useBackgroundBlur(false) / GuiLib.open(blurBackground = false) (no blur behind the screen, dark overlay stays); Ctrl + F12 or GuiLib.open(metrics = true) = metrics overlay (frame time, CPU, memory, leak check)
- Controls: input (text/password/number/checkbox), select/option, checkbox, switch (toggle), slider (range, Float/Int, onChange + onChangeEnd), rangeSlider (two thumbs), numberInput (+/-, clamped, wheel; allowEmpty = true for Int?/Double?; typing 100k / 1.5m / 1b works, parse = { … } for own formats), radioGroup, segmented, chips, multiSelect, select(searchable = true), tabs (animated indicator), details/collapse (accordion, animated height), contextMenu (right-click), useToast() toasts, useClipboard() (copy text), textarea (multi-line, maxLines; input/textarea honour text-align), colorPicker, colorInput, tooltip, modal, portal, text(Component) (Minecraft text with colors, hover text, item tooltips (show_item), click events), useTranslation() (t("key", args), re-renders on language change), sortableList (drag to reorder; group = "x" moves items between lists, auto-scroll, Alt+arrows), img, item (tooltip = true shows the Minecraft item tooltip), entity (FakePlayer for player models), playerHead(name | uuid) (player face), scroll
- CSS: selectors incl. combinators and :hover/:focus/:disabled/:checked/:scrolling (GuiLib-only; `guilib-autohide` class = idle-hiding scrollbar)/:not()/:nth-child() (incl. `of S`), ::before/::after with content (strings, attr()), ::placeholder (input/textarea), caret-color, accent-color (checked/filled parts of controls); flexbox; grid; tables (table/thead/tbody/tfoot/tr/th/td/caption/col, colSpan/rowSpan, border-collapse, border-spacing, table-layout: fixed, vertical-align in cells; tr:hover works); position incl. fixed; var(); calc()/min()/max()/clamp();
  linear/radial/conic gradients (also repeating-*); background-size (cover/contain/lengths), background-position (incl. `right 10px bottom 5px`), background-repeat (repeat-x/space/round), aspect-ratio, outline (+ outline-offset, follows border-radius), text-transform, word-break / overflow-wrap (break long words), line-clamp / -webkit-line-clamp (N lines + …), background-origin/-clip and the full `background` shorthand (`url(x) center / cover no-repeat`) – without size/position/repeat a url() layer is stretched over the box (GuiLib default); transitions and @keyframes animations; transform translate/scale/rotate/skew/matrix; sub/sup and vertical-align on inline text; presence(visible, exitMs) and presenceList(items, key, exitMs) for exit animations (also per list item; sortableList(exitMs = …) for sortable lists); box-shadow (blur, spread, inset, multiple); filter (grayscale/sepia/brightness/contrast/saturate/hue-rotate/invert/opacity exact; blur() and drop-shadow() on boxes and images, text stays sharp); @media (width/height/orientation/aspect-ratio, resolution = GUI scale, range syntax); @supports (property: value) / selector() / not/and/or; @font-face (src: url("mymod:fonts/x.ttf"))
- Dependency: `maven("https://skyblockoverhaul.github.io/maven")`, `implementation(include("net.sbo:guilib-26.2-fabric:<version>")!!)`; license LGPL-3.0
- Differences from the web are listed in docs/AI_GUIDE.md section 6 — read them before writing CSS.

## Docs

- [Docs site](https://skyblockoverhaul.github.io/maven/guilib/): guide + reference with screenshots
- [AI guide / full reference](docs/AI_GUIDE.md): every element, prop, hook, event, CSS property and web difference
- [README](README.md): setup, dependency, dev workflow
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): pipeline (tree → style → layout → paint → events), design decisions (German)

## Examples

- [Showcase](src/main/kotlin/net/sbo/guilib/fabric/showcase/Showcase.kt) and [its CSS](src/main/resources/assets/guilib/showcase/showcase.css)
- SVG icons: `fill="currentColor"` in the SVG takes the element's CSS `color` (tint one icon file from CSS)
- [Default styles](src/main/resources/assets/guilib/css/ua.css) – every color is a `--guilib-*` variable (theme = override them on `:root`)
